instance.hint: Pick a loader and a game version — Hestia downloads the rest
instance.label: Create your first instance

play.hint: The first launch fetches the game files it needs
play.label: Launch it

server.hint: Provisioned at create, with its own port and console
server.label: Host a server

sign_in.hint: A Microsoft account is what playing an instance needs
sign_in.label: Sign in

filters.body: The chips narrow by kind — mods, resource packs, shaders, data packs, modpacks. Modrinth works out of the box; CurseForge appears once you add an API key in Settings, with a filter beside the search to switch source.
filters.title: Narrow it down

search.body: One search covers every enabled source. Paste a Modrinth or CurseForge project link and it resolves straight to the page.
search.title: Search, or paste a link

content.body: Everything installed lands in one pool you can update in place, disable, or pin to a version.
content.title: Mods and packs

play.body: Launch straight into the game, into a world, or onto a server. Several sessions of one instance can run at once.
play.title: Play it

worlds.body: Your saves, with the option to share them across instances rather than copying them around.
worlds.title: Worlds

address.body: The address and port your friends connect to, beside the loader and version it runs.
address.title: How people join

backups.body: Archive the world and config on demand, or on a schedule. A version change backs the server up first.
backups.title: Backups

console.body: A live console over RCON — send commands and watch the output without leaving the app.
console.title: Talk to it

start.body: Start it here. It keeps running once you close the window, so you can come back to it later.
start.title: Bring it up

account.body: Switch between signed-in accounts, or add another. Playing needs one; browsing and hosting do not.
account.title: Your account

create.body: Start a new instance or server here, or import one from a Hestia archive, an .mrpack, or a Prism install.
create.title: Make something

daemon.body: Hestia runs a small background service that owns your servers and sessions — this dot says whether it is up.
daemon.title: Running in the background

nav.body: Library holds what you have. Browse finds content. Instances, Servers and Skins each get a page of their own.
nav.title: Finding your way

play.body: Pick an instance and launch it without leaving this page.
play.title: Straight back in

add.body: Import a PNG and name it. It joins your library and can be applied to the account whenever.
add.title: Add your own

library.body: Your saved skins alongside the vanilla characters and any capes on your account.
library.title: The library

preview.body: A real-time 3D preview of the selected skin and cape. Apply sets it on your Microsoft account.
preview.title: See it first

account.body: Launching an instance needs a Microsoft account. Browsing content, hosting servers and settings all work without one.
account.title: Sign in to play

hello.body: Instances you play and servers you host, in one window. A small background service owns them both, so a server you start stays up after you close the app.
hello.title: Welcome to Hestia

ready.body: Take a short tour of the app, or dive straight in. You can replay it any time from Settings.
ready.title: Ready when you are
